_doc: Ranks earned by deeds (ranks.gd, docs/make_it_fun.md H). Routine XP (sim.gain_xp) raises a skill only up to routine_cap; past it each band of levels is a rank, in `bands` order: a rank holds the levels above the previous cap up to its own `cap_lv`, so the rank is read from the level (ranks.rank_of). When a skill reaches the top of a band, its next rank's trial is open: one of the deeds in `trial` ({deed: count}, any one of them; counts come from the deed record u.deeds, done before or after) steps them into the next band. Routine XP past the top of a band waits (the bar stays full). Deeds: slay_<beast kind> (wolf, tiger), slay_warrior, masterpiece, lead_build (led a frontier outpost to completion), raise_first (finished the tribe's first building of a type in `first_builds`), invent (made a breakthrough), open_era (a breakthrough that opened a new age), repel_raid (in a defence that drove off a war band), win_war (led a war party home), seal_deal (sealed an agreement with a clan), seal_alliance (an alliance), taught_<skill> (someone who once worked under them earned their own first rank in that skill; who worked under whom is u.mentors, filled by contracts). Per skill and rank: title (what they are called), desc (the trial, as the sheet shows it). first_feat: the tribe's first of each rank is an achievement. log, popup, remember: texts of a rank-up (vars: who, title).

_gates_doc: What a rank lets people do (ranks.gd may/tribe_can/tribe_has). Each gate names the skill and rank it takes and its desc (shown on the sheet). A tribe gate holds while anyone living holds the rank; a person gate is about that person. tame: calves are tamed in the pens (sim._herd). big_pens: each pen holds `add` more oxen (sim.ox_cap). fine_craft: upgrades, renovations and bronze working (sim.upgrades_for, renovate_one, has_bronze). keeper: their knowledge keeps every known secret from dying out (evo.on_death). lead_war: may lead a war party (contracts). war_chief: may be appointed War Chief (sim.appoint_block). long_treaties: treaties they seal last `mult` times as long (rivals.seal). The Centurion Aura and the master trader's prices name their rank in rules.json (skills.aura.rank, folk.trade.master_rank). blocked: why a gate is shut (var: the rank's title).

tame.desc: Calves can be tamed in the pens

big_pens.desc: Each pen holds one more ox

keeper.desc: No secret is forgotten while they live

long_treaties.desc: Treaties they seal last half again as long

_rite_doc: A rank-up is named before the tribe at a rite by the fire: at the next dusk when the person is at home (within `reach` of the village, not away on a contract or errand, no emergency, no festival under way), the rite's `actions` run (story.run actions; vars: who (the person, for "$who"), name, title, festival (the rite's name, for the festival action's dancing ring)). epithet: someone without an epithet takes the rank title as one. marks: the colour of the feather each skill's rank puts in a person's hair (world_view; a Master's is longer with a gold tip).

log: By the fire the whole tribe gathers to name %s a %s.

actions.say: I will not shame this name.

taught_log: %s once learned under %s: the teacher's mark is on them.
